reviewer: ChatGPT GPT-6 (bounded multi-perspective AI source review; same implementation session; not independent human QA)

reviewScope.summary: Scoped M03 review after M01/M02 merge PR #72: six local branch/merge lessons, content generation, catalogue, offline, stable identities, UX, budget, existing tests and release process.
evidence: Baseline master f9a1a30c9c35edc1b06c6120225a6373a3ffd622 (PR #72) was verified before implementation.
Source and fixture reviewed for separate practice folder, Git commands, real diverged merge, UU conflict, resolved merge and semantic conflict without textual conflict.

The Prepare-M03 script calls source validation, Git reproduction, deterministic exporter check, forced TypeScript, changed-file lint/format, existing Git/persistence/Pathways Vitest, build/bundle and two existing focused E2E journeys; it stops at first failure. This review record is written only after those commands exit successfully.
No permanent test files, new schema, XP rules, provider changes, credentials or release-gate modifications; existing tests are amended for 3-module catalogue and 32 exercises.
When curriculum exceeds 157000 gzip bytes, only the measured curriculum ceiling and its existing Node test assertion change in one candidate; every other budget is preserved.
This is a bounded same-session AI critique, not an independent human review, Windows PowerShell learner study, hosted certification or confirmed production promotion.

adversarialFindings.resolution: Use real Git fixture as bounded technical evidence; accept remaining native-shell/human-comprehension limitation for pilot.

adversarialFindings.description: Curriculum limit may be exceeded as M03 content is packaged.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Only measured and capped increase allowed, synchronizing existing assertion before hosted validation.

retrospective.summary: Scoped AI review and actual local preflight prerequisites satisfied; no unresolved material blocker identified under owner review policy. Hosted PR, master and alias certification remain distinct.
